This condition arises when there is an excess of reactive oxygen species that damage cells, proteins, and DNA. Oxidative stress is commonly experienced by individuals exposed to environmental pollutants, smokers, and those with poor dietary habits. The mangifera indica plant, also known as the mango tree, contains antioxidants that help combat free radicals and reduce oxidative stress. Regular consumption of mangoes may support the body's natural defenses against this harmful process.

Flavonoids present in mangoes also support cellular health by scavenging free radicals. Together, these constituents help protect cells from damage and promote overall well-being.
